claims.sourceText: NASA NSSDCA master catalogue, spacecraft record for Lunar Orbiter 1 (1966-073A), https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/nmc/spacecraft/display.action?id=1966-073A , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: THE INSTITUTIONAL DISCREPANCY IN THE WOLFE ACCOUNT, FROM NASA'S OWN CATALOGUE. The NSSDCA record for Lunar Orbiter 1 states: 'The Lunar Orbiter program was managed by NASA Langley Research Center', a NASA civil facility at Hampton, Virginia, which is a separate installation from Langley Air Force Base. The same record gives launch on 10 August 1966 and photographic data acquired 'from August 18 to 29, 1966'.

claims.text: Its own NSSDCA master catalogue states that 'The Lunar Orbiter program was managed by NASA Langley Research Center', with Lunar Orbiter 1 launched on 10 August 1966 and photographic data acquired 'from August 18 to 29, 1966, and readout occurred through September 14, 1966'. This is the agency record against which the Karl Wolfe claim, which places Lunar Orbiter imagery at an NSA facility on Langley Air Force Base, must be measured.

edges.label: Carries the Wolfe and Hare claims about NASA imagery, against NASA's own records
edges.note: Wolfe's Lunar Orbiter account runs against the NSSDCA record that the programme was managed by NASA Langley Research Center. Hare's employer, Philco-Ford, is a documented NASA Manned Spacecraft Center contractor per Ford's own corporate history, while her employment is documented nowhere.
